privacy.title: Personal data protection information
privacy.subtitle: Work time tracking
privacy.intro: In accordance with the <1>General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)</1> and <2>Organic Law 3/2018 on Personal Data Protection</2>, we inform you:
privacy.purposeText: Recording your working day in compliance with article 34.9 of the Workers' Statute.
privacy.legalBasisText: Compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 6.1.c GDPR).
privacy.dataText: Name, email, clock-in/clock-out records and breaks.
privacy.retentionText: Minimum 4 years according to current labor legislation.
privacy.recipientsText: Labour Inspectorate and competent authorities when required.
privacy.rightsText: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and objection by contacting your company's Human Resources department.
privacy.noteText: Time tracking is a legal obligation of your employer. Your consent is not required for this processing, but you have the right to be informed about how your data is managed.
privacy.accept: I have read and understood the information
privacy.acceptNote: This information will only be shown once. You can review it at any time from your profile settings.

time.title: Recording your day
time.intro: Record your clock-in and clock-out easily.
time.step1: Press <1>"Create time record"</1> in the main menu.
time.step2: If you work for several companies, <1>select the company</1> concerned.
time.step3: Press the <1>"Clock in"</1> or <2>"Clock out"</2> button as appropriate.
time.note: <1>Note:</1> The system automatically alternates between clock-in and clock-out. If your last record was a clock-in, the next one will be a clock-out.

incident.title: Reporting incidents
incident.intro: Report any problem or special situation related to your working day.
incident.step1: Press <1>"Create incident"</1> in the main menu.
incident.step2: Select the <1>company</1> if you work for several.
incident.step3: Describe the <1>incident</1> in detail in the text field.
incident.examples: <1>Incident examples:</1> I forgot to clock in/out, technical problems, justified absence, etc.

change.title: Requesting record changes
change.intro: If you made a mistake in a record, you can request a correction.
change.step2: Select the <1>date</1> of the record you want to modify.
change.important: <1>Important:</1> The request will remain pending administrator approval.

report.title: Viewing monthly reports
report.intro: View your monthly time reports and download them as PDF.
report.step1: Press <1>"View monthly report"</1> in the main menu.
report.step3: Press <1>"Generate report"</1> to see the summary.
report.step4: Review the daily detail by pressing each row to expand it.
report.step5: Press <1>"Download PDF"</1> to save a copy on your device.
report.note: <1>Note:</1> The report shows hours worked, breaks and the signature status of the month.

signature.title: Signing monthly records
signature.intro: Sign your monthly records to confirm they are correct.
signature.step1: Press <1>"Sign monthly records"</1> in the main menu.
signature.step3: You will see the months awaiting signature. Press <1>"Sign"</1> on the month you want to confirm.
signature.step4: Review the confirmation message and press <1>"Sign"</1> to confirm.
signature.important: <1>Important:</1> The signature is irreversible. Make sure you have reviewed your records before signing. We recommend viewing the monthly report first.

password.title: Changing your password
password.intro: You can change your password at any time from the settings.

install.title: Add to home screen
install.intro: You can add this app to your phone's home screen for faster access, like a native app.
install.ios1: Open this page in <1>Safari</1> (Safari is required).
install.ios2: Press the <1>share</1> icon in the bottom bar.
install.ios3: Scroll and select <1>"Add to Home Screen"</1>.
install.android2: Press the <1>menu</1> icon (three vertical dots) at the top right.
install.android3: Select <1>"Add to Home screen"</1> or <2>"Install app"</2>.
install.advantage: <1>Advantage:</1> Once added, the app opens in full screen, without the browser address bar, offering a more comfortable experience.
